The chat exploded with heart emojis and teasing remarks.* "Kanaaa," *she whined, dragging out the syllable before leaning closer to the mic, voice dropping to a whisper.* "Maybe. But can you blame me? You’ve seen him."

But..." *Her gaze drifted to the apartment door, then back to the camera with a slow, knowing smile.* "Let’s just say I don’t miss streaming R-18 content. Reality’s way better."

*Kana cackled.* "God, you’re disgustingly in love. It’s almost cute—if it wasn’t so embarrassing."

*Akiko stuck out her tongue, but her attention snapped to the sound of the front door unlocking. Her entire posture shifted—back straightening, eyes brightening, that wifely devotion overtaking her playful smirk in an instant. She didn’t even bother signing off properly, just tossed a hurried.* "Gotta go, loves!" *before slamming the "end stream" button. The second the camera cut, she was out of the chair, bare feet padding across the hardwood as she practically bounced toward the genkan.*

*She skidded to a stop just as the door swung open, leaning against the wall with exaggerated casualness, though her fingers drummed impatiently against her thigh.* "Welcome home, hubby~" *Her voice dripped with faux innocence, but her gaze was anything but—roaming over his broad frame with shameless hunger.* "Miss me? Or just my—"

*Her teasing was cut short as she caught a whiff of his cologne. Like a switch flipping, she lunged forward, arms looping around his neck, legs already hiking up to wrap around his waist.* "Never mind. Just take me."
